meta.description: Assigns 16S, ITS and 18S amplicon ASV/OTU taxonomy using DADA2, DECIPHER IDTAXA and QIIME2 region-matched classifiers.
meta.note: final pass: fixed and audited under one brief, see CHECKPOINT.md

scientific_integrity.detail: No fabricated scientific claims were made in any evaluated response.

practice_boundaries.detail: The skill makes no diagnostic or prescriptive medical claim.

methodological_ground.detail: Fresh runs retained region-matching, conservative-rank and database-conditioning safeguards.

code_usability.detail: The QIIME2 workflow and current IDTAXA script ran end to end; DADA2 outputs were produced, with a post-output runtime fault recorded as a recommendation.

functional_suitability.note: All advertised routes are present, but the DADA2 all-NA genus guard accepts a deliberately incompatible reference.

reliability.note: Seeded outputs reproduce, but the incompatible-reference false negative and post-output R crash reduce fault tolerance.

performance_context.note: Memory limits and bounded-reference guidance are explicit.

agent_usability.note: Decision tree, exact commands, outputs and failure modes are clear.

human_usability.note: Natural triggers and rank-reporting limits are clear.

security.note: No credentials, destructive operations or raw user-code execution were found.

maintainability.note: References and executable scripts are separated; the DADA2 sentinel needs a discriminative validation rule.

agent_specific.note: Progressive disclosure and cross-skill handoffs are strong; the current sanity check can falsely confirm a bad input.

key_strengths: Fresh QIIME2 runs exercised both classifier paths and region matching.
Seeded DADA2 and IDTAXA re-runs were reproducible at genus rank.
The split references and scripts make the workflow navigable.
Scope and species-level caveats are unusually explicit.

recommendations.title: QIIME2 filter-seqs uses obsolete option names
recommendations.problem: The documented QIIME2 command uses --i-data and --o-filtered-data, which current QIIME2 rejected.
recommendations.root_cause: The example was written for an older q2-taxa interface.
recommendations.fix: Replace those names with --i-sequences and --o-filtered-sequences, then rerun the fixture.

recommendations.title: DADA2 wrong-reference guard accepts false labels
recommendations.problem: The documented all-NA genus sentinel passed a deliberately incompatible one-sequence reference and reported 770/770 genus calls.
recommendations.root_cause: A nonzero assigned fraction is not evidence that a DADA2 reference matches marker or primer region.
recommendations.fix: Replace the all-NA-only sentinel with a validation check against an expected-region/reference manifest and flag implausible 100 percent single-lineage assignments. Keep the current non-degeneracy check only as a secondary diagnostic.

recommendations.title: DADA2 example exits with a post-output segmentation fault
recommendations.problem: Both shipped-example invocations saved complete outputs then exited through a segmentation fault in this R runtime.
recommendations.root_cause: Likely an R/DADA2 runtime teardown interaction; the source output was complete but the process status was nonzero.
recommendations.fix: Reproduce in a clean R session, report the exact DADA2/R build, and document or eliminate the crash before relying on shell exit status in automation.
